research_question: Does metric-dependent economic compressibility and its market-direction mechanism transfer to six prespecified public portfolio families that never entered model training?

geometry_grid.ridge_rule: 1e-4 times trace of the asset second-moment matrix divided by asset count

primary_estimands: For each family and gamma, the five-seed mean strict-self-pricing squared distance for K in {1,2,3,4,5,8}
Market-direction attenuation = abs(A_f)-abs(A_f_hedged), with betas estimated only in 2000-2009 and frozen
K=1 plus Mkt-RF changes in raw Euler moments and regression alpha relative to K=1

preregistered_hypotheses.H1_geometry_dependence: At least four of six external families select a different best learned dimension at gamma zero and gamma one.
preregistered_hypotheses.H2_market_direction: Validation-frozen market-beta hedging reduces abs(A_f) in at least four of six families and the median family attenuation is positive.
preregistered_hypotheses.H3_economic_completion: Adding Mkt-RF to K=1 lowers both mean absolute raw Euler moments and mean absolute alpha in at least four of six families.
preregistered_hypotheses.H4_asset_family_dependence: Across the twelve family-by-endpoint rankings, at least three distinct learned dimensions are selected as best. This is descriptive confirmation of heterogeneity, not a teacher gate.

inference.reporting_rule: Report every family, seed, endpoint and subperiod. No family may be removed after seeing returns.

stopping_rule: V021 uses frozen models and is the only development-period external-family confirmation run. Do not alter the family list, retrain models or add metrics after seeing results. A failure narrows the claim; it does not reopen architecture search.
